summary: Iteration 6 polish verified end-to-end. Backend regression: 63/63 pytest pass (no change after frontend-only iter6). Frontend: (1) Home og:image meta exactly equals REACT_APP_OG_IMAGE_URL from frontend/.env (verified via getAttribute on meta[property='og:image']); og:site_name == 'Stonebridge Construction Co.' from REACT_APP_SITE_NAME. (2) ProjectDetail (/portfolio/<id>) emits og:image == project's cover_image (Maple Ridge Residence -> images.unsplash.com/photo-1710701455648-... not default) and og:title contains project name. (3) Custom ConfirmDialog (shadcn AlertDialog) replaces window.confirm in all three places — Admin delete project shows title='Delete project?' + project-name description + destructive OK class + Cancel keeps row (6 rows before/after); Dashboard delete document shows title='Delete document?' + doc-name description + Cancel preserves 4 docs; CommentsThread delete shows title='Delete comment?' + Cancel preserves comment. All dialogs expose data-testid=confirm-dialog/confirm-title/confirm-description/confirm-cancel/confirm-ok. (4) Real-time polling (5s interval) verified across 2 separate browser contexts on the same cp_id ('cp_1adc1c5bd4ab'): client posted -> admin saw the new comment within 6.5s without any user action; admin replied -> client saw the reply within 6.5s. Cross-session propagation works in both directions. (5) Polling state-equality short-circuit: code review confirms setComments callback skips state update when prev.length===data.length && every comment_id matches by index — prevents scroll jump on idle polls. (6) #emergent-badge element was NOT present on any page tested (Home, Portfolio, ProjectDetail, Dashboard, Admin) — the auto-inject script did not run in this preview, so the badge is effectively hidden by absence; CSS rule '#emergent-badge { display: none !important }' is present at /app/frontend/src/index.css:92-93 and would hide it if the script later injects. Cleanup: deleted 2 test polling comments via admin -> final DB state restored to 1 seeded welcome comment.
critical_code_review_comments: useConfirm.jsx: clean implementation with promise-based confirm() returning bool; dialog state managed via single resolverRef. One nit: if onOpenChange is fired with v=true (programmatic), resolverRef is not reset, but that path isn't reachable from the current UI — minor.

CommentsThread.jsx: POLL_INTERVAL_MS=5000 + state-equality short-circuit is the right approach. Consider adding an AbortController on api.get to cancel in-flight polls on unmount; currently if cpId changes mid-fetch the resolved promise still calls setComments on the new instance (React will ignore but a stale toast on error could fire) — minor robustness concern.

SEO.jsx now correctly reads from process.env.REACT_APP_OG_IMAGE_URL with empty-string fallback; if env var ever becomes undefined the meta tag will be emitted with content='' which crawlers may flag. Consider falling back to a public/og.png placeholder.

index.css line 92-93 (#emergent-badge display:none) is global and !important — fine, but note that since the badge script may also style its own element via inline styles, !important is required (as written). Verified no other rule shadowing.
Admin.jsx deleteProject and Dashboard.jsx deleteDoc use confirm() from useConfirm and CommentsThread.jsx remove() does the same — DRY is preserved via the hook.
All five iter6 frontend changes ship without any backend coupling; 63/63 backend pytest still pass — perfect zero-regression refactor.

To re-run: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -q` for backend; frontend critical checks are (a) login admin -> /admin -> click delete on a row -> verify [data-testid=confirm-dialog] with title 'Delete project?' and destructive OK; (b) open Talk on a project, post a comment, delete it -> verify same dialog with 'Delete comment?'; (c) two browser contexts on same cp_id with Talk open -> post in one, verify other receives within 6.5s. The badge element is normally not present in preview; CSS rule covers the case when emergent-main.js injects it post-load.
